_comment: VERSIONS ALREADY PUBLISHED TO A STORE. A submission that reuses one of these is REFUSED BY
APPLE, and it is refused LATE - at upload, after a full build has been spent and after a
TestFlight slot has been consumed. `scripts/lib/next-version.mjs` reads this file so the
refusal happens at the START of a build instead.
WHY A FILE AND NOT A LOOKUP: nothing in this repo can read App Store Connect. That is a
console only Tre can see, so the honest mechanism is a record he and the desks maintain,
and the honest thing to say about it is that it CANNOT know about a release nobody wrote
down. What it does do is make the known collision impossible to ship, and it fails LOUD -
a build refusing to start is not a defect that hides.
ADD A LINE THE DAY A VERSION GOES LIVE, never when it is submitted. A version awaiting
review has NOT consumed its number: on 2026-09-19 VERSION was deliberately reverted to
6.7.0 for exactly that reason, so today's fixes could ride that submission rather than the
next one. Recording a submission as released would have blocked that and cost a release.
`released` is the date it went LIVE, from Tre's own confirmation, not the submission date.

released.source: Tre, 2026-09-20: 'yes its live now' (ask df4474ed). Submitted earlier; live on this date.
